tests: init tracks the durable status directory in the bootstrap commit, so a clone of a fleet home carries it

consumesExternalOutput.program: git init, git add -A and git commit, spawned by src/commands/init.ts
consumesExternalOutput.provenance: src/commands/init.ts spawns git init, git add -A and git commit and reads their exit codes, so rule (f) binds this witness (SPAWN_GREP matches the changed file). Section 6 of witness/captures/m4-p18-git-contracts.txt records what that bootstrap produces for the durable status directory, captured 2026-09-17 against git 2.43.0: git ls-files -- status prints status/.gitkeep and exits 0, and a clone of that fleet home carries status/ and charter/ while state/ is absent. The named test asserts the same two facts against a fleet home it builds live, and reads the capture so the recorded contract is anchored to a run rather than standing alone. RESIDUE: the capture covers a local filesystem clone only; it says nothing about a clone over a network transport.
